batch.description: HSTU F Unit (Faculty of Science) MCQ questions, academic session 2014-15, transcribed from the Satt Academy question-bank page on 2026-10-31. Only the 59 complete, reliably readable MCQs from the publicly accessible first page of each subject section are included (15 per subject claimed accessible of 25 per subject; remainder behind site login). One incomplete item (Higher Mathematics Q14, blank option 3 in source) was excluded.
